justification: Inspected `javaparser-core-testing/src/test/resources/com/github/javaparser/issue_samples/issue_2627/Ops_lf.java`, which is 7,632 lines long and declares `public final class Ops` with 328 public methods. The class also exposes 16 public subgroup fields (`nn`, `summary`, `image`, `data`, `io`, `dtypes`, `linalg`, `random`, `strings`, `sparse`, `bitwise`, `math`, `audio`, `signal`, `train`, `quantization`) and many additional forwarding builders plus scope wrappers (`withSubScope`, `withName`, `withControlDependencies`). This breadth and size show a monolithic façade with multiple separable responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is present.
